title: Evaluating financial tail risk forecasts: Testing Equal Predictive Ability
reasoning: The paper is strictly a technical study in the field of financial econometrics and statistics. It investigates the performance of predictive ability tests like the Diebold-Mariano and Model Confidence Set procedures in the context of tail risk measures like Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES). There is no component related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
